text: In 2024, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) and the DICT rolled out the Digital National ID. Aside from the national ID website, through which government mobile application can registered PhilSys holders access it?
explanation: As of November 2026, the Digital National ID can be accessed through the national ID website or the eGovPH app, according to PSA advisories and reports from June to August 2024 on the PSA-DICT rollout.
hint: Think of the single 'super app' that bundles many government services.
whyB: The LTMS portal is the LTO's system for licenses and vehicle registration. It does not issue the national ID.
whyC: The PhilHealth portal handles health insurance membership, not PhilSys identity credentials.
whyD: The DFA system is only for booking passport appointments.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, makukuha ang Digital National ID sa national ID website o sa eGovPH app. Ito ang ni-roll out ng PSA at DICT noong 2024, ayon sa PSA advisories at news reports noong June hanggang August 2024.
hintTl: Isipin mo yung isang 'super app' na pinagsama-sama ang maraming government services.

text: PhilHealth launched YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program) on July 25, 2025 as its revitalized primary care benefit package. It is an evolution of which earlier PhilHealth package?
explanation: As of November 2026, PhilHealth describes YAKAP, launched July 25, 2025, as an evolution of the Konsulta (Konsultasyong Sulit at Tama) primary care package, now with more medicines, laboratory tests and cancer screening (PhilHealth news release, July 2025).
hint: The older package's name sounds like a doctor's check-up.
whyA: The Z Benefits Package covers catastrophic illnesses like cancer treatment. It is not a primary care package.
whyC: Malasakit Centers are one-stop shops for medical assistance in hospitals. They are not a PhilHealth primary care package.
whyD: The Point-of-Service program enrolls unregistered patients at the point of care. It is not the predecessor of YAKAP.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ayon sa PhilHealth news release noong July 2025, ang YAKAP (inilunsad July 25, 2025) ay evolution ng Konsulta package. Mas marami na itong libreng gamot, lab tests at cancer screening.
hintTl: Yung dating pangalan, parang pagpapa-check-up sa doktor.

text: The Department of Health's Zero Balance Billing policy, declared nationwide after the July 28, 2025 State of the Nation Address, means patients pay no hospital bill for which of the following?
optionA: Private rooms in any government or private hospital
optionB: All admissions in PhilHealth-accredited private hospitals
optionD: Outpatient consultations in LGU rural health units only
explanation: As of November 2026, Zero Balance Billing covers patients admitted to basic or ward accommodation in DOH-run hospitals. It was soft-launched in May 2025 and made nationwide after the July 28, 2025 SONA (PTV News, July 31, 2025).
hint: It is limited to the hospitals the DOH itself operates, and not the fancier rooms.
whyA: Private rooms are excluded. Only basic or ward accommodation is covered.
whyB: Private hospitals still charge fees. The policy applies to DOH-run hospitals.
whyD: The policy is about hospital admissions in DOH hospitals, not LGU outpatient consultations.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, sakop ng Zero Balance Billing ang mga pasyenteng naka-admit sa basic o ward accommodation sa DOH-run hospitals. Na-soft launch ito noong May 2025 at naging nationwide pagkatapos ng SONA noong July 28, 2025 (PTV News, July 31, 2025).
hintTl: Sa mga ospital lang ng DOH mismo, at hindi yung mga mamahaling kwarto.

text: The DOH opened the first BUCAS center in Sto. Tomas, Pampanga in March 2024 to provide urgent and outpatient care without hospital admission. What does BUCAS stand for?
optionA: Barangay Urgent Care and Ambulance Service
optionB: Bagong Universal Clinic and Ambulatory Support
optionC: Bayanihan Urgent Care and Assistance Service
optionD: Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Service
explanation: As of November 2026, BUCAS stands for Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Service. The first center opened on March 6, 2024 at Jose B. Lingad Memorial General Hospital in Sto. Tomas, Pampanga (GMA News, March 6, 2024).
hint: The acronym starts with the 'Bagong' of the administration's slogan and ends with outpatient-type service.
whyA: BUCAS centers are DOH facilities, not barangay ambulance services.
whyB: The 'U' stands for Urgent, not Universal, and the 'S' is Service, not Support.
whyC: The 'B' stands for Bagong, not Bayanihan.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ang BUCAS ay Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Service. Binuksan ang unang center noong March 6, 2024 sa Jose B. Lingad Memorial General Hospital, Sto. Tomas, Pampanga (GMA News).
hintTl: Nagsisimula sa 'Bagong' at tungkol sa outpatient o 'ambulatory' na serbisyo.

text: Under DepEd Order No. 10, s. 2024, the MATATAG Curriculum began its phased implementation in School Year 2024-2025 in which grade levels?
explanation: As of November 2026, DepEd's MATATAG Curriculum FAQ and DO 10, s. 2024 (July 2024) state that implementation started in SY 2024-2025 for Kindergarten and Grades 1, 4 and 7. Grades 2, 5 and 8 followed in SY 2025-2026.
hint: The rollout started at the first year of each key stage.
whyB: Grades 2 and 3 come later in the phasing (SY 2025-2026 and SY 2026-2027).
whyC: MATATAG is a revised K to 10 curriculum. Grade 11 is senior high school and is not part of it.
whyD: Only Grade 4 started in SY 2024-2025. Grades 5 and 6 come in later years.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ayon sa DepEd MATATAG FAQ at DO 10, s. 2024 (July 2024), nagsimula ang MATATAG noong SY 2024-2025 sa Kinder, Grade 1, Grade 4 at Grade 7. Sumunod ang Grades 2, 5 at 8 noong SY 2025-2026.
hintTl: Sinimulan sa unang baitang ng bawat key stage.

text: MULA (Multispectral Unit for Land Assessment), the Philippines' biggest satellite yet at about 130 kilograms, is being built by the Philippine Space Agency together with a satellite company from which country?
explanation: As of November 2026, MULA is being built by PhilSA with Surrey Satellite Technology Ltd (SSTL) of the United Kingdom and was undergoing space environment testing in the UK. PhilSA eyed a possible April 2027 launch (SSTL news, 2025; Manila Bulletin, August 29, 2026).
hint: The partner company is named after an English county.
whyA: Japanese universities helped build the earlier Diwata microsatellites, not MULA.
whyC: The US company SpaceX is only the planned launch provider, not the co-builder.
whyD: South Korea is not MULA's development partner.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, binubuo ng PhilSA ang MULA kasama ang Surrey Satellite Technology Ltd (SSTL) ng United Kingdom. Nasa space environment testing pa ito sa UK, at April 2027 ang tinitingnang launch (SSTL news, 2025; Manila Bulletin, August 29, 2026).
hintTl: Ang partner company ay ipinangalan sa isang county sa England.

text: What is the theme of the Philippines' 2026 ASEAN Chairmanship, launched on November 14, 2025?
explanation: As of November 2026, the Philippines' ASEAN 2026 theme is 'Navigating Our Future, Together', unveiled at the chairship launch on November 14, 2025 (Philstar and Manila Bulletin, November 2025).
hint: The theme is a seafaring image that fits an archipelago.
whyA: This was Lao PDR's theme for its 2024 chairmanship.
whyB: This was Indonesia's theme for its 2023 chairmanship.
whyD: This was Malaysia's theme for its 2025 chairmanship.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ang theme ng ASEAN 2026 chairship ng Pilipinas ay 'Navigating Our Future, Together'. Inilabas ito sa launch noong November 14, 2025 (Philstar at Manila Bulletin, November 2025).
hintTl: Parang paglalayag o pag-navigate sa dagat, bagay sa isang archipelago.

text: The 48th ASEAN Summit, the first leaders' summit under the Philippines' 2026 chairship, was held on May 8, 2026 in which city?
explanation: As of November 2026, the 48th ASEAN Summit was held in Cebu on May 8, 2026, according to the Chair's Statement published on asean.org (May 9, 2026). The 49th Summit followed in Metro Manila in November 2026.
hint: It is the Queen City of the South.
whyA: Davao City did not host the 48th Summit.
whyB: Iloilo City did not host the 48th Summit.
whyC: Baguio City did not host the 48th Summit.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ginanap ang 48th ASEAN Summit sa Cebu noong May 8, 2026, ayon sa Chair's Statement sa asean.org. Sumunod ang 49th Summit sa Metro Manila noong November 2026.
hintTl: Ito yung tinatawag na Queen City of the South.

text: Which country takes over the ASEAN Chairmanship from the Philippines for 2027?
explanation: As of November 2026, Singapore takes over the ASEAN chair from the Philippines for 2027, as PM Lawrence Wong confirmed after meeting President Marcos on July 15, 2026 (The Star and Inquirer, July 2026).
hint: ASEAN rotates the chair alphabetically, and this country comes right after 'Philippines'.
whyB: Thailand comes after Singapore in the alphabetical rotation.
whyC: Myanmar deferred its turn. That is why the Philippines took the 2026 chair.
whyD: Malaysia was the 2025 chair, the year before the Philippines.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, Singapore ang papalit sa Pilipinas bilang ASEAN chair sa 2027. Kinumpirma ito ni PM Lawrence Wong matapos ang meeting nila ni President Marcos noong July 15, 2026 (The Star, Inquirer).
hintTl: Alphabetical ang rotation ng ASEAN chair. Sino ang kasunod ng 'Philippines'?

text: At the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur on October 26, 2025, which country was formally admitted as ASEAN's 11th member state?
explanation: As of November 2026, Timor-Leste is ASEAN's 11th member. It was formally admitted on October 26, 2025 at the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur, the bloc's first expansion since Cambodia in 1999 (The ASEAN Magazine; The Star, October 26, 2025).
hint: It applied in 2011 and had been an ASEAN observer since 2022.
whyA: Papua New Guinea is an ASEAN observer, not a member.
whyC: Bangladesh is in South Asia and is not an ASEAN member.
whyD: Sri Lanka is in South Asia and is not an ASEAN member.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ang Timor-Leste ang 11th member ng ASEAN. Pormal itong tinanggap noong October 26, 2025 sa 47th ASEAN Summit sa Kuala Lumpur, ang unang expansion mula Cambodia noong 1999 (The ASEAN Magazine; The Star).
hintTl: Nag-apply ito noong 2011 at naging observer noong 2022.

text: On July 8, 2024, the Philippines signed a Reciprocal Access Agreement (RAA) in Manila that allows each country's forces to enter the other's territory for joint military exercises. With which country was it signed?
explanation: As of November 2026, the Philippines-Japan Reciprocal Access Agreement was signed in Manila on July 8, 2024 by Defense Secretary Teodoro and Japanese Foreign Minister Kamikawa (Inquirer and ABS-CBN, July 8, 2024).
hint: This country's Foreign Minister came to Malacanang to sign it, and it was the country's third such deal after the UK and Australia.
whyA: The Philippines' troop-access pact with the US is the 1998 Visiting Forces Agreement, not an RAA.
whyB: Australia's pact with the Philippines is the 2007 Status of Visiting Forces Agreement.
whyD: France did not sign an RAA with the Philippines on that date.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, pinirmahan ang Philippines-Japan Reciprocal Access Agreement sa Manila noong July 8, 2024 nina Defense Secretary Teodoro at Japanese Foreign Minister Kamikawa (Inquirer, ABS-CBN).
hintTl: Pangatlong ganitong kasunduan ito ng bansang ito, kasunod ng UK at Australia.

text: On November 14, 2026, during the 28th ASEAN Economic Community Council Meeting in Manila, ASEAN member states signed the bloc's first standalone, legally binding agreement setting common rules on digital trade, cross-border data flows and electronic payments. What is it?
explanation: As of November 2026, ASEAN signed the Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) in Manila on November 14, 2026. It replaces the 2019 ASEAN e-commerce agreement (The Star, November 14, 2026; Vera Files).
hint: Its name covers the whole digital economy, not just online selling.
whyA: RCEP is a free trade agreement signed in 2020 with ASEAN's partners such as China, Japan and Korea.
whyB: The ASEAN Agreement on Electronic Commerce dates from 2019. DEFA is set to replace it.
whyC: ATIGA covers trade in goods and dates from 2009.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, pinirmahan ng ASEAN ang Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) sa Manila noong November 14, 2026. Papalitan nito ang 2019 ASEAN e-commerce agreement (The Star; Vera Files).
hintTl: Buong digital economy ang sakop ng pangalan, hindi lang online selling.

text: On December 9, 2024, PHIVOLCS raised Alert Level 3 after an explosive summit eruption sent a plume about 3,000 meters high, prompting evacuations within a 6-kilometer radius. Which volcano erupted?
explanation: As of November 2026, PHIVOLCS records that Kanlaon Volcano on Negros Island erupted at 3:03 p.m. on December 9, 2024, and its alert was raised from Level 2 to Level 3 (PHIVOLCS eruption update, December 10, 2024; Philstar).
hint: It straddles Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental.
whyB: Taal is in Batangas and was not raised to Alert Level 3 on that date.
whyC: Mayon in Albay was not the volcano that erupted on December 9, 2024.
whyD: Bulusan in Sorsogon was not raised to Alert Level 3 on that date.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ayon sa PHIVOLCS, pumutok ang Kanlaon Volcano sa Negros Island noong 3:03 p.m., December 9, 2024. Itinaas ang alert mula Level 2 papuntang Level 3 (PHIVOLCS update, December 10, 2024; Philstar).
hintTl: Nasa pagitan ito ng Negros Occidental at Negros Oriental.

text: PHIVOLCS identified which newly named fault as the source of the magnitude 6.9 earthquake that struck offshore northern Cebu on September 30, 2025, the strongest recorded in the province?
explanation: As of November 2026, PHIVOLCS confirmed in early October 2025 that the newly identified Bogo Bay Fault, a right-lateral strike-slip fault, generated the September 30, 2025 M6.9 offshore northern Cebu quake (PHIVOLCS earthquake poster; Manila Bulletin, October 3, 2025).
hint: The fault is named after the city closest to the epicenter.
whyA: PHIVOLCS did not name the Philippine Fault Zone as the source. It traced the quake to a newly identified local offshore fault.
whyC: The Manila Trench lies west of Luzon, far from Cebu.
whyD: The West Valley Fault is in Metro Manila and nearby provinces.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, kinumpirma ng PHIVOLCS noong early October 2025 na ang bagong tukoy na Bogo Bay Fault ang pinagmulan ng M6.9 na lindol sa northern Cebu noong September 30, 2025 (PHIVOLCS poster; Manila Bulletin, October 3, 2025).
hintTl: Ipinangalan ito sa city na pinakamalapit sa epicenter.

text: The magnitude 7.4 earthquake offshore Manay, Davao Oriental on October 10, 2025, which prompted a tsunami warning for eastern coastal provinces, originated along which structure according to PHIVOLCS?
explanation: As of November 2026, PHIVOLCS Director Teresito Bacolcol said on October 10, 2025 that the M7.4 offshore Davao Oriental quake originated along the Philippine Trench, east of Mindanao (SunStar, October 10, 2025; PHIVOLCS primer).
hint: It is the deep trench off the Pacific side of the country.
whyA: The Cotabato Trench lies off western Mindanao, on the opposite side from Davao Oriental.
whyB: The Manila Trench lies west of Luzon.
whyD: The West Valley Fault is an onland fault in Metro Manila, not off Mindanao.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, sinabi ni PHIVOLCS Director Bacolcol noong October 10, 2025 na sa Philippine Trench nanggaling ang M7.4 na lindol offshore Davao Oriental (SunStar; PHIVOLCS primer).
hintTl: Yung malalim na trench sa Pacific side ng bansa.

text: In July 2024, the Philippines was selected from eight country offers to host the Board of which international climate fund?
optionD: Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage
explanation: As of November 2026, the Philippines hosts the Board of the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage. It was selected on July 9, 2024 at the Board's meeting in Songdo, Korea, through a DENR-led inter-agency bid (UNFCCC and DFA releases, July 2024).
hint: The fund pays for climate impacts that adaptation can no longer prevent.
whyA: The Green Climate Fund is hosted in Songdo, South Korea, not the Philippines.
whyB: The Adaptation Fund is a separate older fund and was not part of this selection.
whyC: The GEF is based in Washington, D.C. and was not part of this selection.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, Pilipinas ang host ng Board ng Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage. Napili ito noong July 9, 2024 sa Board meeting sa Songdo, Korea, sa bid na pinangunahan ng DENR (UNFCCC at DFA, July 2024).
hintTl: Para sa pinsalang dulot ng climate change na hindi na kayang i-adapt.

text: The Philippines hosted the 2024 Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction (APMCDRR) at the PICC in October 2024 in partnership with which United Nations office?
optionA: UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
optionC: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Secretariat
explanation: As of November 2026, the 2024 APMCDRR (October 14-18, 2024, PICC) was hosted by the Philippines in partnership with UNDRR. It is the region's main platform for carrying out the Sendai Framework (UNDRR APMCDRR 2024 site; Daily Tribune, October 17, 2024).
hint: The UN office whose mandate matches the conference's own name.
whyB: UNEP handles environmental matters broadly and was not the conference partner.
whyC: The UNFCCC Secretariat runs the climate COPs, not the APMCDRR.
whyD: UNDP supports development work but was not the co-organizer.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ang 2024 APMCDRR (October 14-18, 2024 sa PICC) ay hinost ng Pilipinas kasama ang UNDRR. Ito ang main platform sa region para sa Sendai Framework (UNDRR site; Daily Tribune).
hintTl: Yung UN office na kapareho ng pangalan ng conference.

text: Republic Act No. 12079, signed in December 2024, amended the National Internal Revenue Code to give a VAT refund on goods bought in the Philippines to which group?
optionA: Overseas Filipino workers on home vacation
optionB: Non-resident foreign tourists who take the goods out of the country
optionC: Senior citizens and persons with disabilities
optionD: Registered export enterprises in economic zones
explanation: As of November 2026, RA 12079 (December 2024) adds Section 112-A to the NIRC: non-resident foreign passport holders get a VAT refund on goods bought in person at accredited stores (at least P3,000 per receipt) and taken out of the country within 60 days. The Department of Finance runs it through VAT refund operators.
hint: The law was meant to make the Philippines more attractive as a shopping destination.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, ang RA 12079 (December 2024) ay nagdagdag ng Section 112-A sa NIRC: ang mga non-resident foreign tourist ay pwedeng mag-claim ng VAT refund sa goods na binili nila sa accredited stores (minimum P3,000 per receipt) basta mailabas nila ng bansa within 60 days. Ang Department of Finance ang nagpapatakbo nito kasama ang VAT refund operators.
hintTl: Ginawa ang batas para maging mas attractive ang Pilipinas bilang shopping destination.
whyA: OFWs are Filipinos, not the non-resident foreign passport holders the law covers.
whyC: Seniors and PWDs already have VAT exemptions under their own laws (RA 9994, RA 10754); RA 12079 is about tourists.
whyD: Export enterprises have their own zero-rating rules under CREATE; this law is a refund for shoppers, not businesses.

text: In February 2025, the Philippines was removed from the 'grey list' of jurisdictions under increased monitoring, after being listed since June 2021. Which international body maintains this list?
optionB: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
explanation: As of November 2026, the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) removed the Philippines from its grey list at its February 21, 2025 plenary in Paris. The Anti-Money Laundering Council welcomed the decision (Inquirer; Philstar, February 2025).
hint: It is the global watchdog on money laundering and terrorist financing.
whyA: The IMF lends to countries and monitors their economies. It does not keep the AML grey list.
whyB: The OECD keeps tax-cooperation lists, not the FATF grey list.
whyD: The World Bank finances development and does not keep the grey list.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, inalis ng Financial Action Task Force (FATF) ang Pilipinas sa grey list noong February 21, 2025 sa plenary sa Paris. Natuwa rito ang Anti-Money Laundering Council (Inquirer; Philstar).
hintTl: Global watchdog ito laban sa money laundering at terrorist financing.

text: Under Batas Pambansa Blg. 72, how did the results of the 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN) conducted by the PSA become official for all purposes?
optionA: By approval of Congress through a joint resolution
optionB: By certification of the Commission on Elections
optionC: By publication of the results on the PSA website
explanation: As of November 2026, the 2024 POPCEN count of 112,729,484 Filipinos (as of July 1, 2024) became official through Proclamation No. 973, signed July 11, 2025, as BP 72 requires (Lawphil text of Proclamation No. 973; Inquirer, July 2025).
hint: It takes the signature of the Chief Executive.
whyA: Congress does not approve census results. BP 72 requires executive action.
whyB: COMELEC uses census data but does not make it official.
whyC: The PSA releases the counts, but they are official only after the President's proclamation.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, naging official ang 2024 POPCEN count na 112,729,484 (as of July 1, 2024) sa pamamagitan ng Proclamation No. 973 na pinirmahan noong July 11, 2025, ayon sa BP 72 (Lawphil; Inquirer).
hintTl: Kailangan ng pirma ng Chief Executive.

text: The BSP unveiled the P500, P100 and P50 notes of the First Philippine Polymer Banknote Series in December 2024, each featuring native wildlife. Which animal appears on the P500 polymer note?
explanation: As of November 2026, the P500 polymer note shows the Visayan spotted deer, the P100 the Palawan peacock-pheasant and the P50 the Visayan leopard cat. The BSP unveiled them on December 19, 2024 and released them on December 23, 2024 (GMA News; Philstar).
hint: It is a hoofed mammal found in Panay and Negros.
whyA: The Philippine eagle is on the P1,000 polymer note introduced in 2022.
whyC: The Palawan peacock-pheasant is on the P100 polymer note.
whyD: The Visayan leopard cat is on the P50 polymer note.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, Visayan spotted deer ang nasa P500 polymer note, Palawan peacock-pheasant sa P100, at Visayan leopard cat sa P50. Inilabas ng BSP noong December 19, 2024 at umikot na noong December 23, 2024 (GMA News; Philstar).
hintTl: Hayop na may kuko (hoofed), makikita sa Panay at Negros.

text: At the Paris 2024 Olympics, Carlos Yulo became the first Filipino to win two Olympic gold medals. In which events did he win them?
optionB: Men's pommel horse and still rings
optionC: Men's parallel bars and horizontal bar
optionD: Men's individual all-around and floor exercise
explanation: As of November 2026, Yulo won the men's floor exercise on August 3, 2024 and the vault on August 4, 2024 at Paris 2024, the Philippines' first double Olympic gold (Philstar, August 5, 2024; ABS-CBN).
hint: One event uses the whole mat, and the other has a run and a springboard.
whyB: Yulo did not medal on pommel horse or rings in Paris.
whyC: Yulo did not medal on parallel bars or the horizontal bar in Paris.
whyD: Yulo did not win the all-around. His second gold was in vault.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, nanalo si Yulo ng gold sa men's floor exercise (August 3, 2024) at vault (August 4, 2024) sa Paris 2024, ang kauna-unahang double Olympic gold ng Pilipinas (Philstar; ABS-CBN).
hintTl: Yung isa, buong mat ang gamit. Yung isa, may takbo at springboard.

text: Besides Carlos Yulo's two golds, the Philippines won two bronze medals in boxing at the Paris 2024 Olympics, its best-ever Olympic haul. Who won them?
explanation: As of November 2026, Aira Villegas (women's 50 kg) and Nesthy Petecio (women's 57 kg) each won bronze at Paris 2024, giving the Philippines 2 golds and 2 bronzes, its best Olympic finish (GMA News; Philstar, August 2024).
hint: Both medalists were women, and one of them had already won silver in Tokyo.
whyA: Marcial and Paalam both competed in Paris but did not medal.
whyB: Bacyadan competed in Paris but did not win a medal. Only Petecio in this pair medaled.
whyD: Villegas medaled, but Marcial did not.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, sina Aira Villegas (women's 50 kg) at Nesthy Petecio (women's 57 kg) ang nag-bronze sa Paris 2024. Kaya 2 gold at 2 bronze ang Pilipinas, ang best Olympic finish natin (GMA News; Philstar).
hintTl: Parehong babae, at yung isa may silver na noong Tokyo.

text: In August 2026, Alex Eala came from a set down to beat top seed Jessica Pegula, 4-6, 6-4, 6-0, and win her first-ever WTA 500 singles title. Which tournament did she win?
explanation: As of November 2026, Eala won the Mubadala DC Open in Washington in early August 2026, her first WTA 500 title, which the WTA called her first WTA Tour title (Philstar, August 4, 2026; GMA News).
hint: The tournament is in the US capital.
whyA: At the 2025 Miami Open, Eala lost to Pegula in the semifinals.
whyB: Her 2025 Guadalajara title was a lower-tier WTA 125 event, not a WTA 500.
whyC: Her Birmingham title was also a WTA 125 event, not a WTA 500.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, napanalunan ni Eala ang Mubadala DC Open sa Washington noong early August 2026. Ito ang first WTA 500 title niya, na tinawag ng WTA na first WTA Tour title niya (Philstar, August 4, 2026; GMA News).
hintTl: Nasa capital ng US ang tournament na ito.

text: Which Lav Diaz film, starring Gael Garcia Bernal and premiered in the Cannes Premiere section in May 2025, was chosen as the Philippines' official entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards?
explanation: As of November 2026, the Film Academy of the Philippines picked 'Magellan' as the country's entry to the 98th Oscars in early September 2025, after its world premiere at Cannes on May 18, 2025 (Manila Bulletin and GMA News, September 2025).
hint: The film is about the Portuguese explorer who died in Mactan in 1521.
whyA: 'Green Bones' was considered, but it is not a Lav Diaz film and was not chosen.
whyB: 'Hello, Love, Again' was considered but not chosen, and it is not a Lav Diaz film.
whyD: 'Sunshine' was considered but not chosen, and it is not a Lav Diaz film.
explanationTl: As of November 2026, 'Magellan' ang pinili ng Film Academy of the Philippines na entry sa 98th Oscars noong early September 2025, matapos ang world premiere nito sa Cannes noong May 18, 2025 (Manila Bulletin; GMA News).
hintTl: Tungkol sa Portuguese explorer na namatay sa Mactan noong 1521.
